newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss 3-mth money market claims yield 1.230 pct.
newsitem.headline: Swiss 3-mth money market claims yield 1.230 pct.

text.p: The annual yield on the latest issue of Swiss federal government three-month money market claims is 1.230 percent, down from the previous issue's 1.549 percent, the Swiss National Bank said.
The latest issue, to be paid for on May 29, raised 779.25 million Swiss francs and was priced at 99.690 percent.
The previous issue, paid for on May 22, raised 1,211.10 million and was priced at 99.610 percent. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
